lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.15 - A Listen. Then act it out.

details: Listen and act checks understanding of the story and builds confidence using the structures.
Look for careful listening, confident repetition and clear pronunciation.
“Our friends have all gone to the fair today but they are not having the best time. First, Rosa lost Minh and Kevinr. Let’s find out what happened.”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Follow): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video, then act it out): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.16 - B. Choose the correct answer

details: Choose the correct answer checks comprehension as students identify the correct answer from three choices.
Look for correct identification and neat circling of the answers.
“Rosa was very sensible asking the policeman for help. Let’s answer these questions to see how he helped find her friends.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:
Check and encourage Ss to complete the project prompts so that they are ready to present by lesson 7,

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.69 - A Read, write and number

details: Read, write and number checks comprehension of the story and practises accuracy. Write tests students’ ability to write a word or phrase correctly using clues and visuals.
Look for correct responses and correct completion of bookwork.
“Oh dear. Anna has also lost her friends! Can you help fill in the gaps to see what’s happened?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.16 - C Make your own story.Write and colour. Act it out with your friends.

details: Make your own story gives students the opportunity to personalise a story by colouring or using stickers of their choice. Students practise speaking by acting out the story.
Look for accurate word choice and sticker placement inside the story pictures. Also correct pronunciation and authentic intonation when acting out the story.
“What would you do if you lost a friend? Make your own story!”

Look for clear pronunciation of words in the sentences and confident repetition.
